message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a stylized oil rig structure rising from a body of water. The central structure is composed of multiple levels with flat platforms, rectangular buildings, and latticed metal support legs extending into the water. Two large crane structures, one grey and one orange, rise vertically from the rig. The orange crane is taller and positioned to the right. Several black, curved pipes protrude from the water's surface, with white foam suggests motion around their bases. The water is rendered in shades of grey-blue with horizontal ripple lines.

The background is a solid off-white color. The top of the image contains large red text: "TEMPO". Smaller black text above it reads "RAPUHNYA SEL BADAN NARKOTIK" and "KISRUH NAWA CITA JOKOWI". Below the title, the date "6-12 APRIL 2015" is visible. To the left, large black text reads "SIAPA MENGINTAI BLOK MAHAKAM" above a smaller paragraph. A barcode, the price "RP 39.500", and a website URL are located in the bottom-left corner. A thick red border frames the left and bottom sides.
